title: Codemagic Patch install survey answer (v1)
description: Wire contract for the one answer `cmpatch selfhost install` POSTs to the collector (https://telemetry.codemagicpatch.dev/v1/install-survey) when the operator answers "How did you hear about us?" after a first install. The body is plain JSON under 2 KiB and carries the chosen answer, the install path, and, for `other` only, the text as typed. It carries no identity: no instance id, no install id, nothing about the machine or the operator. The root schema is the lenient envelope the collector enforces at runtime; `strictAnswer` is the exact shape current senders produce and is what the CLI's and the collector's contract tests validate fixtures against.
$comment: Evolution rules: additive-only within v1. The collector ignores unknown fields and counts an `answer` or `install` slug it does not list as `other`, so a newer CLI never gets a 400 for a choice this file does not list yet. `schema_version` is bumped only for breaking changes.

schema_version.description: Wire-format major version. Always 1 for this schema.

answer.description: The chosen answer. Current senders send `ai-assistant`, `search-engine`, `colleague-community-docs`, `events-outreach-ads`, or `other`; any other slug is counted as `other`.

install.description: The install path that asked the question. Current senders send `ssh`, `ngrok`, or `fly`; any other slug is counted as `other`. `smoke` is the deploy smoke value: accepted and never stored.

other_text.description: Free text typed after choosing `other`, at most 200 characters. Read only when `answer` is `other`.

strictAnswer.title: Install survey answer, exact shape of current senders
strictAnswer.description: What the CLI produces today: a listed answer and install path, no extras, and `other_text` (never empty) only with `other`. Contract tests validate fixtures against this; the collector enforces only `answer`.
